title: Priority in courts.
bodyText: All actions brought pursuant to this chapter or pursuant to the rules adopted under this chapter or pursuant to the conditions of a permit issued under this chapter shall in the discretion of the court receive priority in the courts of the State.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: The amendment made by L 2014, c 218, §8 is not included in this section.

bodyHtml:
[§342B-54]  Priority in courts.  All actions brought pursuant to this chapter or pursuant to the rules adopted under this chapter or pursuant to the conditions of a permit issued under this chapter shall in the discretion of the court receive priority in the courts of the State. [L 1992, c 240, pt of §1]

 

Note

 

  The amendment made by L 2014, c 218, §8 is not included in this section.
